svg.text: Michael as built, 2026-10-03. Pins with the same label are connected; × is not connected. U7, U8 and U10 run from +3V3.
capacitive touch version; touch (I²C) not connected
From ../fpga/spi-display/WIRING.md. The '245s take Michael's 5 V signals on their B side to the Cmod's 3.3 V A side. DIR and /OE are grounded.
Cmod pins carry the FPGA design's port names (spi-display/constr/cmod_a7.xdc); U10's MISO is read only by the display probe.
The Cmod runs from Michael's +5V through D2 (band towards the Cmod), so its USB is needed only for programming.
U11: the LM1117's data sheet asks for 10 µF on its output for stability (and on its input). None is fitted; add them in a new build.
